title: a feature typed by its own owner does not kill the checker
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4 review). `asPresident : Person` inside `Person` names an unbounded tower of dotted scopes (`asPresident.asPresident…`). Both value-scope name collectors guarded the walk with a key that carried the dotted prefix, which never repeats while the prefix grows, so the recursion ran until the stack died and the whole checker answered `import/internal-error` with NO validation output. C6 made this ordinary input: a `:>> p` that binds hands the reference the self-typed type it previously lacked. The cycle guard is keyed on the owner alone now.
